title: C: full L2 node and gateway CCP2 integration
description:
Integrate zephyr.03-.13 through lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lichen_l2_tx.c, routing/router.c, lichen/apps/gateway/src/rpl_root.c and forwarding.c. All origin, control, forwarding, retry and baseline SCHC traffic must use receiver-aware scheduling and shared physical-resource accounting. Explicitly verify zephyr.05's full-operation geometry beyond zephyr.06's reused frame-plus-guard minimum at the actual driver boundary. Preserve queue/deadline/back-pressure and custody policy.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.

Decomposition review scope: Explicitly own or verify and reuse bounded coalescing of pending, explicitly replaceable position/status updates in the C/Zephyr application-to-L2 enqueue path. Keep the latest value only for the same resource/recipient/context. Do not coalesce distinct messages, commands, receipts, historical samples or custody records. Prefer the pre-protection boundary; preserve existing security interfaces and nonce lifecycle.
design: Reuse 0l5j.4's compatibility work and current L2/gateway owners, not another stack. vectors.14 is the separate C production-consumer leaf and is not a reverse prerequisite here. b7z9.45 helper fixes and 7wpz CoAP response integration stay outside this rewrite; reference 7wpz only if its existing scoped response contract is needed. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil/radio-owned identity, baseline SCHC/security and best-effort custody. Key portability is deferred and audited OSCORE/EDHOC internals remain human-only.
acceptance_criteria:
Run independent wire/calendar/airtime/queue/ledger cases through real L2/node/gateway paths, asserting no transmit bypass, no queued-TX preemption of RX, correct complete signed-frame charges and rejection when setup/CCA/turnaround/response plus one guard exceeds the boundary. Exercise lichen/tests/ping_l2, routing_dispatch, regional_duty_cycle and affected gateway native suites on local Linux/heft. Compile affected node/gateway and LR1110/SX12xx target configurations against the verified lichen/west.yml pin, currently v4.1.0; record SDK/west/features and run sanitizers/lint. No ports, RF measurements or authorization claims.

Additional required acceptance: Native production tests cover the positive coalescing cases commissioned by vectors.08 and ci.09, with an identified implementation/reuse owner. Nonreplaceable and distinct-context cases remain separate; no new congestion controller or human-only OSCORE edit is implied.
notes: Task-definition amendment after independent decomposition review. This commissions future work only; nothing was implemented or tested. The initial CLI-input fingerprint is retained as initial_scope_sha256; current native Beads fields are authoritative. Do not rerun the seed applicator over this reviewed amendment.
